summary: Irenic Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K announcing that, effective June 18, 2026, holders of its units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and warrants. No fractional warrants will be issued. This is a routine administrative step following an IPO, not a special situation. The announcement does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or management change.
